subject: AMVI
question: Output of alternators employed in automobile electrical system is regulated by a:
explanation: In an automotive alternator charging system, the output voltage is regulated by a voltage regulator (electromechanical or solid-state electronic IC). A current regulator is not required because an alternator has natural self-limiting current characteristics due to stator inductive reactance, and built-in diodes prevent reverse discharge.

subject: AMVI
question: The resilience of a material id considered when it is subjected to :
explanation: Resilience is the mechanical property of a material to absorb energy when deformed elastically and release that energy upon unloading without permanent deformation. It is the primary design consideration for components subject to impact and shock loading (e.g. suspension springs).

subject: AMVI
question: Which gearbox uses synchronizing unit?
explanation: A synchromesh gearbox incorporates synchronizing cone clutches and dog teeth units to equalize the rotational speeds of the gear and the mainshaft before engagement, eliminating the need for double-declutching and preventing gear clashing.

subject: AMVI
question: Pulsation of clutch pedal is due to :
explanation: Pulsation or vibration felt in the clutch pedal during initial depression is commonly caused by mechanical angular or parallel misalignment between the engine crankshaft axis and the transmission input shaft, or by unevenly adjusted clutch release levers.

subject: AMVI
question: Test conducted on injector are:
explanation: Standard workshop tests performed on a diesel fuel injector nozzle using a nozzle tester include: (1) Opening pressure test (pop-up pressure setting), (2) Leak-off test (checking clearance leakage between nozzle needle and body), (3) Spray pattern test (atomization and cone angle), and (4) Chatter / drippiness test.

subject: AMVI
question: Circumferential grooves on automobile

options.C: Prevent small stones sticking to the tyre

explanation: Circumferential grooves running around the perimeter of automotive tyre treads provide open channels for expelling water rapidly from beneath the tyre contact patch, preventing hydroplaning (aquaplaning) and reducing the danger of lateral skidding on wet roads.

subject: AMVI
question: Super elevation is .......... of a horizontal curved portion of a road
explanation: Super-elevation (banking) in road geometry is the inward transverse inclination provided to the outer edge of a highway pavement across a horizontal curve, elevating the outer edge above the inner edge to counteract the overturning and outward skidding tendencies caused by centrifugal force.

subject: AMVI
question: Excessive clutch free pedal play would cause:
explanation: Excessive clutch pedal free play means the clutch release bearing does not travel far enough when the pedal is depressed to the floor. Consequently, the pressure plate does not fully release the driven plate, causing clutch drag and difficult gear shifting.

subject: AMVI
question: Aerodynamic drag on a vehicle is experienced most when the vehicle:
explanation: Aerodynamic drag force is proportional to the square of vehicle speed: Fd = 1/2 * rho * Cd * A * v^2. At low speeds, rolling resistance dominates, but at high cruising speeds, aerodynamic drag becomes the single largest resistance opposing vehicle motion.

subject: AMVI
question: A.C. mechanical fuel pump tests are;
explanation: The standard shop tests for an A.C. mechanical diaphragm fuel pump include: (1) Pressure test (checking fuel delivery pressure, typically 0.2 to 0.35 bar), (2) Volume test (checking fuel discharge volume per minute/strokes), and (3) Vacuum test (checking the suction created at the inlet).

subject: AMVI
question: Example of multi grade oil is:
explanation: SAE 20W-40 (or SAE 20-40) is a multigrade engine oil formulated with viscosity index improvers so that it behaves like a thin SAE 20 oil at low temperatures for easy cold starting, while retaining the lubricating film strength of an SAE 40 oil at high engine operating temperatures.

subject: AMVI
question: A manual method commonly used for measuring the engine lubricating oil level is
explanation: An engine oil dipstick is the universal manual workshop tool used to measure the static lubricating oil level in the engine crankcase sump, featuring engraved 'MAX' and 'MIN' level marks.

subject: AMVI
question: Cylinder block construction by mono-block is preferred to individual cylinder construction because of:
explanation: Monoblock cylinder block construction (casting all cylinders together in a single rigid block) offers compact overall engine dimensions, streamlined mass production, higher structural rigidity, and eliminates problematic water-jacket sealing joints between separate cylinders.

subject: AMVI
question: The standard firing order of a six cylinder in-line left hand crank shaft is:
explanation: The standard and most universally adopted firing order for a six-cylinder in-line four-stroke automotive engine is 1 - 5 - 3 - 6 - 2 - 4, which ensures optimal dynamic balance and evenly distributed bearing loads along the crankshaft.

subject: AMVI
question: The purpose of circumferential fins constructed on the outer periphery of the brake drum is to:

options.A: Reduce the weight of the drum

explanation: Circumferential cooling fins cast onto the external outer periphery of heavy-duty brake drums increase the effective surface area exposed to ambient airflow, enhancing convective heat dissipation and significantly lowering brake operating temperatures to prevent brake fade.

subject: AMVI
question: EBD is a .............. device in modern vehicle
explanation: EBD stands for Electronic Brakeforce Distribution, an active brake safety assistance system that works in conjunction with ABS to automatically vary the proportion of braking force applied to each individual wheel based on dynamic load conditions and available road grip.

subject: AMVI
question: The part of a torque converter that facilitates change of torque between input and Output shafts is the:
explanation: A hydraulic torque converter contains three main elements: the engine-driven impeller (pump), the output turbine, and the stationary stator (reactor). The stator redirects the fluid returning from the turbine back into the impeller in the direction of rotation, multiplying engine torque.

subject: AMVI
question: Odometer is used to measure:
explanation: An odometer is an instrument integrated into the vehicle dashboard instrument cluster that records and displays the total cumulative distance traveled by the vehicle in kilometres or miles.

subject: AMVI
question: Which thermodynamic law provide the basis of temperature measurement ?
explanation: The Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics states that if two thermodynamic systems are each in thermal equilibrium with a third system, they are in thermal equilibrium with each other. This principle provides the foundational physical basis for temperature measurement and thermometers.

subject: AMVI
question: In a Mac Pherson strut type of independent suspension, the coil spring is arranged:

options.A: Between the lower wish bone and the cross member
options.B: Between the lower wish bone and the strut
options.C: Between the strut and the cross member
options.D: On a strut carrying the shock absorber

explanation: In a MacPherson strut independent front suspension, the coil spring is concentrically mounted directly on the telescopic structural strut that encloses the hydraulic shock absorber (damper), forming a compact integrated suspension unit.

subject: AMVI
question: Crumbling zone:

options.A: Structural region designed to collapse in a crash-absorbing energy

explanation: A crumple zone (crumbling zone) is a structural section at the front and rear of a vehicle's body designed to progressively deform, buckle, and crush during a crash, thereby absorbing impact energy and decelerating the passenger cabin safely.

subject: AMVI
question: The advantage of hypoid gear final drive over spiral bevel gear final drive is

options.A: Propeller shaft can be positioned up or down

explanation: The hypoid gear final drive has its pinion axis offset below (or above) the center line of the crown wheel. This offset lowers the propeller shaft line, allowing vehicle manufacturers to lower the floor line and center of gravity of the passenger cabin without needing a large transmission tunnel.

subject: AMVI
question: Purpose of thermostat valve is;

options.A: Allow engine to attain working temperature

explanation: The thermostat valve in an engine water cooling system prevents coolant from flowing to the radiator when the engine is cold, recirculating it within the cylinder block and head until the engine rapidly attains its optimum operating temperature (typically 80°C to 90°C).

subject: AMVI
question: The term 'clutch slip' as applied to a fluid flywheel:

options.A: Decreases with the speed of driving shaft
options.B: Increases with the speed of driving shaft
options.C: Remains steady at all speeds of the driving shaft
options.D: Remains steady at all speeds of the driven shaft

explanation: In a fluid flywheel (fluid coupling), 'clutch slip' is the difference in rotational speed between the driving impeller and the driven runner. At engine idle speed, slip is nearly 100% (zero torque transmission), but as the driving shaft speed increases, centrifugal fluid circulation increases and slip decreases to around 2-3% at cruising speeds.

subject: AMVI
question: All types of live axles have to take:
explanation: All live axles (semi-floating, three-quarter floating, and full-floating) transmit driving torque to the road wheels. However, in a full-floating axle, the axle casing carries the vehicle weight and bending loads, so the axle shaft itself takes only driving torque.

subject: AMVI
question: Expansion tank is employed in .......... system
explanation: An expansion tank (coolant recovery reservoir) is an integral component of a closed liquid engine cooling system that provides space for the thermal expansion and contraction of engine coolant as its temperature fluctuates.

subject: AMVI
question: Heat dam is cut in
explanation: A heat dam is a narrow circumferential groove cut into the top land of the piston above the top compression ring groove. It restricts the conduction of intense combustion heat from the piston crown down to the compression rings, protecting the rings from sticking.

subject: AMVI
question: Which is not the common component between a petrol and a diesel engine?
explanation: An ignition coil is present in a petrol (Spark Ignition) engine to generate the high voltage spark across spark plugs. Diesel (Compression Ignition) engines rely on the heat of compression to ignite the fuel spray and do not use an ignition coil.

subject: AMVI
question: Volumetric efficiency of an engine is increased by :

options.B: Using more number of piston rings
options.C: Increasing gap between head and piston

explanation: Volumetric efficiency is directly governed by breathing resistance. Using a larger-diameter inlet valve (or multiple intake valves per cylinder) increases the cross-sectional intake flow area, decreases throttling losses, and admits a greater mass of air-fuel mixture into the cylinder.

subject: AMVI
question: As per the section IV of Motor Vehicle Act 1988, the minimum age limit for obtaining a driving licence to drive a transport vehicle is:
explanation: Under Section 4(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, no person under the age of twenty (20) years shall drive a transport vehicle in any public place.

subject: AMVI
question: The principal use of an engine dynamometer is to measure:

options.D: Net work done by the engine

explanation: An engine dynamometer (such as a hydraulic, eddy-current, or prony brake dynamometer) primarily measures the braking torque (T) developed by the engine output shaft at a known rotational speed (N), from which the Brake Power (BP = 2 * pi * N * T / 60) is computed.

subject: AMVI
question: Reference fuels used for cetane rating of CI engines fuels would include:
explanation: The reference fuels used for determining the Cetane rating of diesel fuels are: pure Cetane (n-hexadecane, assigned a rating of 100) and alpha-methyl naphthalene (assigned a rating of 0, or heptamethylnonane assigned 15).

subject: AMVI
question: Engine is a mechanical device which convert
explanation: A heat engine is a machine or mechanical device that converts the thermal (heat) energy released from the combustion of fuel into mechanical work or kinetic energy.

subject: AMVI
question: Forces acting on rear axle:
explanation: The rear live axle of an automobile is subjected to multiple structural forces: vertical vehicle weight and dynamic shock loads, lateral side thrust (cornering forces), and driving torque / braking torque reaction.

subject: AMVI
question: Specific heat is the amount of heat required to rise the temperature :

options.A: By unit degree of a substance
options.B: By unit degree of unit mass of substance

explanation: Specific heat capacity (c) of a substance is defined as the quantity of heat energy required to raise the temperature of a unit mass of the substance by one unit degree of temperature (Q = m * c * delta_T).

subject: AMVI
question: Speed limit is included in :
explanation: A speed limit sign (a circular traffic sign featuring a red circular border enclosing black numerals indicating speed on a white background) is classified under the Motor Vehicles Act as a Mandatory (Regulatory) traffic sign, which must be strictly obeyed by all drivers.

subject: AMVI
question: Brake caliper is :

options.B: used for measuring brake pad thickness

explanation: In an automotive disc brake assembly, the brake caliper is the housing that straddles the brake disc rotor, accommodating the hydraulic pistons and clamping the friction brake pads against the spinning disc faces.

subject: AMVI
question: Materials having same elastic properties in all directions is called :
explanation: An isotropic material (noted as 'Isentropic material' in historical question prints) is an ideal engineering material that exhibits identical elastic and physical properties (modulus of elasticity, Poisson's ratio, etc.) in all directions at any point.

subject: AMVI
question: One liter of water occupies a volume of :
explanation: One litre of pure water occupies a volume of exactly 1,000 cubic centimetres (1,000 cm^3 or 1 cubic decimetre = 10^-3 m^3).

subject: AMVI
question: An engine has clearance volume by 10 CC and swept volume is 70 CC. The compression ratio is:
explanation: Compression Ratio (r) is calculated as: r = (Vs + Vc) / Vc. Given swept volume Vs = 70 cc and clearance volume Vc = 10 cc: r = (70 + 10) / 10 = 80 / 10 = 8:1.

subject: AMVI
question: A high viscosity index of lubricating oil indicates:

options.A: Relatively little change of viscosity with change of pressure
options.B: Relatively large change of viscosity with change of pressure
options.C: Relatively little change of viscosity with change of temperature
options.D: Relatively large change of viscosity with change of temperature

explanation: A high Viscosity Index (VI) indicates that the lubricating oil exhibits relatively little change in its dynamic viscosity across wide changes in operating temperature, ensuring fluid lubrication during cold morning starting and maintaining protective film thickness at high engine loads.

subject: AMVI
question: The testing and adjustment of a diesel injection pump for the accuracy of its firing interval is known as:
explanation: Phasing is the shop testing and adjustment of a multi-cylinder diesel inline fuel injection pump to ensure that the start of fuel delivery from each pumping element occurs at precisely the correct angular intervals (e.g. exactly 90° apart on a 4-cylinder pump, 60° on a 6-cylinder pump). Calibration ensures equal delivery quantity.

subject: AMVI
question: The purpose of a condenser in the ignition system of a petrol engine is to:

options.A: Regulate current produced by the dynamo
options.C: Avoid arcing across the contact breaker points
options.D: Distribute high voltage to the engine cylinder according to the firing order

explanation: The ignition condenser (capacitor) connected across the contact breaker points absorbs the primary back-EMF when the points open, preventing electrical arcing across the gap, thereby ensuring rapid collapse of the primary magnetic field and protecting the points from burning.

subject: AMVI
question: Viscous coupling is employed instead of ............ in modern vehicles
explanation: In modern all-wheel-drive (AWD) vehicles, a viscous coupling unit (containing interleaved slotted plates immersed in high-viscosity silicone fluid) is employed in place of a conventional mechanical center differential to smoothly transfer torque between front and rear axles during wheel slip.

subject: AMVI
question: FFV stands for :
explanation: FFV stands for Flex-Fuel Vehicle (Flexible-Fuel Vehicle), which is an alternative-fuel automobile equipped with an internal combustion engine capable of operating on gasoline blended with varying percentages of ethanol or methanol (up to 85% or 100%).

subject: AMVI
question: In case of offset pistons, the piston pin hole axis is made offset from the cylinder centreline towards the:
explanation: In offset pistons, the piston pin bore axis is offset slightly (typically 1 mm to 1.5 mm) from the cylinder centerline towards the major thrust side (the side supporting connecting rod angle during the power stroke) to minimize piston slap.

subject: AMVI
question: Important properties of lubricating oil:
explanation: The essential functional properties required of an automotive lubricating oil include: proper viscosity and high viscosity index, physical stability (resistance to foaming, low pour point, high flash point), and chemical stability (resistance to thermal oxidation, corrosion, and sludge formation).

subject: AMVI
question: Slip angle is:

options.A: Angle between the two front wheel direction
options.B: Angle between King pin centre line and Wheel centre line
options.C: Angle between direction of travel of car and direction in which tyre is pointing

explanation: Slip angle is the angular difference between the actual direction of travel of the vehicle (the wheel heading) and the longitudinal plane in which the tyre is pointing when subject to lateral cornering forces.

subject: AMVI
question: In an alternator, the electromotive force is induced in the:
explanation: In an automotive alternator, the alternating electromotive force (AC voltage) is induced in the stationary three-phase stator windings as the rotating magnetic field produced by the DC-excited rotor passes across them.

subject: AMVI
question: Specific gravity of a lubricating oil can be determined by a:
explanation: The specific gravity of liquid petroleum products and lubricating oils is measured using a hydrometer (or pycnometer) calibrated for liquid density measurement.

subject: AMVI
question: A.C Mechanical pump is employed in :
explanation: An A.C. mechanical pump (AC diaphragm fuel pump) is an engine-driven positive-displacement pump actuated by an eccentric cam on the engine camshaft to draw fuel from the petrol tank and supply it to the carburettor in older IC engines.

subject: AMVI
question: Volumetric efficiency is the ratio of :

options.A: Volume of charge admitted at NTP to swept volume

explanation: Volumetric efficiency (eta_v) of an internal combustion engine is the ratio of the actual mass (or volume reduced to Normal Temperature and Pressure - NTP) of fresh air-fuel mixture or air drawn into the cylinder during the intake stroke to the theoretical swept volume of the cylinder.

subject: AMVI
question: The Motor vehicle to which semi- trailer is attached is called :
explanation: Under Section 2(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, a motor vehicle to which a semi-trailer is attached (comprising a prime mover tractor unit articulated with a trailing semi-trailer) is defined as an 'Articulated Vehicle'.

subject: AMVI
question: The type of gears used for transmitting power between two non-intersecting perpendicular shafts is
explanation: Hypoid bevel gears are specialized spiral bevel gears where the axes of the driving pinion and driven crown wheel are non-intersecting and perpendicular, allowing the pinion shaft to be offset below the center of the ring gear.

subject: AMVI
question: Knocking tendency in a SI engine reduces with increasing:
explanation: In a Spark Ignition engine, increasing engine speed increases in-cylinder charge turbulence and flame propagation speed, significantly reducing the residence time available for the unburned end gas to reach its self-ignition temperature, thereby reducing the knocking tendency.

subject: AMVI
question: The following is not a part of secondary side of ignition system;
explanation: In a battery ignition system, the contact breaker (CB) points are connected in the low-voltage primary circuit (12 V) in series with the primary winding. The secondary high-voltage circuit consists of the secondary winding, distributor rotor, distributor cap, high-tension cables, and spark plugs.

subject: AMVI
question: Wankel engine is a
explanation: The Wankel engine is a rotary internal combustion engine that uses an eccentric rotary design (a triangular Reuleaux rotor orbiting inside an epitrochoidal housing) instead of reciprocating pistons to convert thermal energy directly into rotational motion.

subject: AMVI
question: A wet clutch is more preferred to a dry clutch:

options.A: When it is desired to disengage the clutch speedily
options.B: When it is desired to transmit large amount of torque effectively
options.C: When it is desired to achieve longer life

explanation: A wet (oil-immersed multi-plate) clutch is preferred over a dry clutch when longer operating life, smooth progressive engagement, and excellent heat dissipation under frequent engagement cycles are required (such as in motorcycles and automatic transmissions).

subject: AMVI
question: The type of reflector used for automobile head lamp is:
explanation: Automotive headlamp reflectors use a parabolic contour because any light ray emitted from a light source placed at the focus of a paraboloid is reflected forward in a parallel beam of high intensity.

subject: AMVI
question: Engine lubricating oil pumps are usually positive displacement types because they are suitable for:
explanation: Automotive oil pumps (such as gear, rotor, or crescent pumps) are positive displacement pumps because they deliver a positive volume of oil per revolution, making them reliable and suitable across the wide, variable speed range of automobile engines.

subject: AMVI
question: Which among the followings is a surface finishing operation?
explanation: Honing is an abrasive micro-finishing machining operation performed on engine cylinder bores using rotating and reciprocating abrasive stones (hones) to create a precision geometric bore with a characteristic cross-hatch surface pattern that retains lubricating oil.

subject: AMVI
question: Winch is not correct as regards to an open type combustion chamber

options.C: No auxiliary starting devices are required
options.D: Lower surface area to volume ratio

explanation: An open (direct injection - DI) combustion chamber features low fuel consumption, excellent thermal efficiency, lower surface-to-volume ratio, and easy cold starting without glow plugs. However, it experiences rapid cylinder pressure rise (high dp/dt), resulting in noisier operation and 'diesel knock', so smooth running is NOT a characteristic.

subject: AMVI
question: An aerodynamic device mounted usually at the rear of an automobile to reduce lift at high speeds is:
explanation: A spoiler is an aerodynamic wing or lip device mounted at the rear of an automobile designed to 'spoil' unfavourable airflow, disrupt aerodynamic lift, and generate negative downforce at high speeds to improve traction and high-speed directional stability.

subject: AMVI
question: An electric motor is a prime mover which converts:
explanation: An electric motor is an electromechanical prime mover that converts electrical energy into mechanical rotational energy through the interaction of magnetic fields and current-carrying conductors.

subject: AMVI
question: Bharath stage III would come into force Nationwide from:
explanation: Bharat Stage III (BS-III) emission standards came into force nationwide across India on 1st April 2010 (having been implemented earlier in 13 major cities in 2005).

subject: AMVI
question: Clutch is provided with:
explanation: An automotive friction clutch driven plate is provided with cushion springs (cushioning/wavy segments between friction facings) for smooth engagement, torsion/coil damping springs in the central hub to absorb crankshaft torsional vibrations, and anti-rattle springs to prevent idle gear chatter.

subject: AMVI
question: In C.

options.A: V. fuel pump fuel delivery is varied by:    (a) Changing the position of injector.
options.C: Changing the position of delivery value.

explanation: In a C.A.V. (Bosch-type) inline diesel fuel injection pump, the quantity of fuel delivered per stroke is varied by rotating the plunger via the control rack and toothed pinion sleeve, which alters the point at which the plunger's helical groove uncovers the spill port, changing the effective stroke.

subject: AMVI
question: Piston compression rings are made of:
explanation: Automotive piston compression rings are manufactured from high-grade alloy cast iron (such as spheroidal graphite or grey cast iron with chromium/molybdenum additions) to provide excellent wear resistance, elasticity, low friction, and compatibility with the cylinder bore.

subject: AMVI
question: Mandatory traffic signs
explanation: Mandatory (regulatory) traffic signs are statutory road signs (usually circular with red borders) that convey legal prohibitions, restrictions, and obligations that road users are legally bound to follow strictly under the Motor Vehicles Act.

subject: AMVI
question: Cause of rapid tyre wear is:
explanation: Rapid and abnormal tyre wear can be caused by overloading the vehicle, mechanical misalignment of steering/suspension geometry (excessive toe or camber), or improper tyre inflation (under-inflation causes shoulder wear, over-inflation causes center tread wear).

subject: AMVI
question: Basic principle of hydraulic brake system is:
explanation: The hydraulic braking system operates on Pascal's Law, which states that any external pressure applied to a confined static fluid is transmitted equally and undiminished in all directions throughout the fluid and to the walls of the containing vessel.

subject: AMVI
question: Convertible:

options.A: Type of car body with hard roof
options.B: Car can be converted from closed to open by folding collapsible roof
options.C: Type of closed car body with shorter passenger compartment

explanation: A convertible is a type of automobile passenger car body featuring a folding, retractable, or collapsible soft fabric or hard roof that allows the vehicle to be readily converted between an open-top car and an enclosed car.

subject: AMVI
question: The drawing which help the sheet metal worker to prepare models the most:
explanation: Development of surfaces is the branch of engineering drawing in which the complete surface of a 3D solid is unfolded or laid out flat onto a 2D plane, providing the exact pattern/template for sheet metal workers to cut, bend, and fabricate components.

subject: AMVI
question: Octane number of LPG fuel is:
explanation: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) consists primarily of propane and butane, having a Research Octane Number (RON) typically between 105 and 110, which is significantly higher than that of iso-octane (octane rating 100).

subject: AMVI
question: Dual brake system:

options.A: There are separate front and rear brakes to safeguard brake failure
options.B: There are no separate front and rear brakes
options.C: Brakes are operated by single master cylinder

explanation: A dual (split) hydraulic brake system utilizes a tandem master cylinder with two independent hydraulic circuits (e.g. front/rear split or diagonal split) ensuring that if one hydraulic circuit fails due to leakage, braking capability is still retained on the other circuit.

subject: AMVI
question: All of the followings are the merits of a side valve (L-head) operating mechanism, except:
explanation: A side-valve (L-head) engine has valves located in the cylinder block beside the cylinder. While it features low height, fewer moving parts, low cost, and quiet operation, its convoluted intake gas path severely restricts airflow, resulting in low volumetric efficiency (unlike OHV/OHC).

subject: AMVI
question: The fins at the top of a motor cycle engine cylinder are larger than those at the bottom because

options.B: Top of the engine is the hottest part
options.C: Extra strength is required at the top
options.D: They are in an unexposed position

explanation: In an air-cooled motorcycle engine cylinder, the combustion chamber is located at the top (cylinder head), where the highest peak temperatures and heat fluxes occur. Therefore, the cooling fins are made largest at the top to provide greater surface area for heat dissipation.

subject: AMVI
question: The function of an inter cooler in multi stage compressor is :

options.A: to increase the quantity of air delivered
options.C: to protect compressor components from over heating
options.D: to cool the air and to minimize the work of compression

explanation: In a multi-stage reciprocating air compressor, an intercooler is installed between consecutive stages to cool the compressed air back to near-ambient temperature before entering the next cylinder, which minimizes the compression work and approaches ideal isothermal compression.

subject: AMVI
question: Scrub radius is :

options.A: Distance between king pin axis on the ground and wheel contact point on the ground

explanation: Scrub radius (steering roll radius) is the horizontal distance measured on the ground surface between the projected center line of the kingpin (steering axis) and the center of the tyre contact patch.

subject: AMVI
question: HUD is a term linked with .......... of the modern vehicle
explanation: HUD (Head-Up Display) is a modern cockpit instrumentation display system that projects key vehicle gauges (such as digital vehicle speed, navigation turn arrows, and warnings) directly onto the lower portion of the front windshield within the driver's forward field of view.

subject: AMVI
question: Unloader valve in air brake system:
explanation: The unloader valve in a commercial vehicle air brake system regulates reservoir line pressure by venting the compressor discharge to the atmosphere (or holding the compressor intake valves open) when the air reservoir reaches the predetermined cutout pressure (e.g. 8 bar).

subject: AMVI
question: The mechanical efficiency of an impulse turbine is :

options.A: ratio of actual work available at turbine to the energy imparted to the wheel
options.B: ratio of actual power produced by the turbine to the energy actually supplied by the turbine
options.C: ratio of work done on the wheel to the energy of the jet

explanation: The mechanical efficiency of a water turbine (such as a Pelton impulse turbine) is the ratio of the actual mechanical shaft power delivered at the turbine runner shaft to the power imparted by the water jet to the turbine wheel.

subject: AMVI
question: A structure used ti dam up a stream or a river, over which the water flows is called :
explanation: A weir is a masonry, concrete, or timber barrier structure built across an open stream or river over which the water flows freely with a free surface, used primarily to dam up water or measure the volumetric flow discharge.

subject: AMVI
question: A single cylinder 2 stroke engine is rotating at 2000 r.p.m. The number of power strokes produced per minute is:
explanation: In a two-stroke engine, every single revolution of the crankshaft produces one power stroke (number of power strokes per minute N = engine RPM). Therefore, at 2000 RPM, a single cylinder two-stroke engine produces exactly 2,000 power strokes per minute.

subject: AMVI
question: The ratio of side force to the angle is called :
explanation: Cornering power is the ratio of lateral cornering force generated by a turning tyre to the resulting tyre slip angle (measured in N/degree or kN/rad): Cornering Power = Cornering Force / Slip Angle.

subject: AMVI
question: The ratio of work done per cycle to the stroke volume of the compressor is known as :
explanation: Mean Effective Pressure (MEP or Pm) is the theoretical constant average pressure which, if exerted on the piston throughout the power stroke, would produce the same net work output per cycle as the actual varying pressure: Pm = Net Work done per cycle / Stroke Volume.

subject: AMVI
question: Drive axle can be removed without jacking up the vehicle and removing tyre:
explanation: In a full-floating rear axle, the wheel hub is supported directly on the axle casing by two opposed roller bearings, meaning the axle casing carries all vehicle weight, bending, and side thrust. The axle shaft transmits purely torsional driving torque and can be withdrawn completely without jacking up the wheel or removing the tyre.

subject: AMVI
question: Cracked cell covers of a lead acid battery is a symptom of:
explanation: Cracked cell covers and distorted battery cases are characteristic symptoms of an overcharged battery, where sustained severe overcharging causes high internal operating temperatures, severe electrolyte boiling and gassing, and plate expansion/buckling.

subject: AMVI
question: Multi-hole type diesel injectors are generally employed in:
explanation: Multi-hole diesel injector nozzles (featuring 4 to 8 fine spray holes) are employed in open (direct injection) combustion chambers where the fuel spray must be widely dispersed and distributed throughout the large open combustion space.

subject: AMVI
question: Which of the following has no unit ?
explanation: Strain is the ratio of change in dimension to original dimension (e.g. delta_L / L). Since it is a ratio of two identical physical quantities of length, strain is a pure, dimensionless number having no unit.

subject: AMVI
question: Torsion bar is used for :
explanation: A torsion bar is a straight spring-steel bar used in automotive vehicle suspension systems. One end is fixed to the chassis frame and the other to a suspension control arm; vertical wheel deflections twist the bar elastically, absorbing road shocks.

subject: AMVI
question: Relief valve is fitted in pump of lubrication system

options.C: Maintain supply of oil in lines
options.D: To relieve the pressure when pressure becomes excessive due to clogged lines

explanation: The pressure relief valve fitted in the engine lubrication pump relieves excessive oil pressure when line pressure rises beyond the design limit (e.g. during cold morning starting with thick oil or clogged passages), discharging excess oil back to the oil sump.

subject: AMVI
question: Camber angle:

options.A: Angle which wheels are titled from vertical
options.B: Angle formed between vertical and king pin centre line the plane of wheel.

explanation: Camber angle is the inward or outward tilt of the front road wheels from the true vertical plane when viewed from the front of the vehicle. If the top of the wheel tilts outward, it is positive camber; if it tilts inward, it is negative camber.

subject: AMVI
question: Which one of the following carburettors does not contain separate accelerating pump circuit?
explanation: The S.U. carburettor (constant depression type) does not require a separate accelerating pump. Instead, an oil damper inside the hollow piston rod hydraulically resists rapid upward piston movement during sudden throttle opening, momentarily creating high intake depression that draws an enriched mixture.

subject: AMVI
question: VVT-i is employed to operate :
explanation: VVT-i (Variable Valve Timing with intelligence) is an automotive electro-hydraulic valve train mechanism (developed by Toyota) that continuously optimizes the opening and closing overlap timing of intake and exhaust valves relative to engine speed and load.

subject: AMVI
question: In fully charged condition positive plated of a lead acid battery is:
explanation: In a fully charged lead-acid storage battery, the active material on the positive plates is lead peroxide (lead dioxide, PbO2, chocolate brown color), while the negative plates consist of pure spongy lead (Pb, slate grey color).

subject: AMVI
question: Stroke of an I.C engine equals:
explanation: The piston stroke (L) is the linear distance traversed by the piston between Top Dead Center (TDC) and Bottom Dead Center (BDC), which is geometrically equal to twice the crankshaft throw radius: Stroke = 2 * crank radius (L = 2r).

subject: AMVI
question: Engine exhaust brake:

options.A: Closes the butterfly valve in exhaust manifold
options.B: Closes the butterfly valve in inlet manifold

explanation: An engine exhaust brake operates by closing a butterfly throttle valve placed in the exhaust pipe/manifold. This restricts exhaust gas discharge, creating high back pressure in the cylinders during the exhaust stroke, converting the engine into an energy-absorbing air compressor to slow the vehicle.

subject: AMVI
question: Insufficient contact breaker gap results in:
explanation: An insufficient (too small) contact breaker point gap increases the dwell angle, delays the opening of the points, and causes arcing and point bounce at high engine speeds, which weakens the spark and causes engine misfiring at high speeds.

subject: AMVI
question: Sealed beam unit is a part of :
explanation: A sealed beam unit is a one-piece hermetically sealed automotive headlamp assembly in which the parabolic reflector, incandescent filament (or halogen capsule), and front prismatic lens are fused into a single airtight glass envelope.

subject: AMVI
question: In CI engines CRI stands for:
explanation: In Compression Ignition (diesel) engines, CRDI or CRI stands for Common Rail Injection system (or Common Rail Diesel Injection), where a high-pressure pump delivers fuel to a shared fuel rail that supplies individual electronically controlled solenoid or piezoelectric injectors.

subject: AMVI
question: Folo- Thru drive employed in :
explanation: The 'Folo-Thru' drive is an automotive starting motor inertia pinion engagement mechanism (an enhanced development of the Bendix drive) equipped with a spring-loaded lock pin that prevents the starter pinion from accidentally disengaging from the flywheel ring gear during false starts until the engine fires reliably.

subject: AMVI
question: PV diagram of Otto cycle have:

options.D: 1 constant pressure, 1 constant volume and 2 adiabatic.

explanation: The air standard Otto cycle consists of four reversible thermodynamic processes on a P-V diagram: two reversible adiabatic (isentropic) processes (compression and expansion) and two constant-volume (isochoric) processes (heat addition and heat rejection).

subject: AMVI
question: Spark plug gap is generally measured by a:
explanation: The spark plug electrode gap is measured and adjusted using a feeler gauge (specifically a round wire feeler gauge, which accurately measures between the curved eroded surfaces of the center and ground electrodes).

subject: AMVI
question: Cylinder head gaskets are:
explanation: Automotive cylinder head gaskets are conventionally constructed of copper and asbestos sandwich type (or modern multi-layer steel - MLS gaskets) to withstand high cylinder combustion pressures, temperatures, and seal oil/coolant passages.

subject: AMVI
question: An automobile engine is an example of:
explanation: An internal combustion automotive engine is an Open Thermodynamic System because it continuously exchanges both matter (taking in air and fuel, discharging exhaust gases) and energy (heat and work) across its system control boundaries.

subject: AMVI
question: Hammering the metal below recrystallisation temperature is;
explanation: Cold working refers to plastic deformation (such as hammering, rolling, or drawing) of a metal at a temperature below its recrystallization temperature, which increases hardness and yield strength through strain hardening (work hardening).

subject: AMVI
question: Anti dazzle devices are used in .......... system
explanation: Anti-dazzle devices (such as optical dipped-beam shields, asymmetrical lens prisms, auto-dimming headlamps, and matrix LEDs) are integrated into automotive headlamp systems to prevent blinding glare to drivers of oncoming vehicles.

subject: AMVI
question: Which one of the followings is not considered for calculating the unsprung weight?
explanation: Unsprung weight includes all parts of the vehicle located between the road surface and the suspension springs (such as road wheels, tyres, brakes, stub axles, steering knuckles, and live axle casings). The chassis frame is carried above the springs, making it sprung weight.

subject: AMVI
question: A petrol engine requires a lean air fuel mixture at:
explanation: An internal combustion petrol engine operates most economically with a lean air-fuel mixture (around 15.5:1 to 16.5:1) during medium-speed, steady cruising conditions. Idling, starting, and acceleration require rich mixtures.

subject: AMVI
question: Rotary motion of  steering wheel is converted to reciprocating motion by:
explanation: The rotary motion of the steering wheel and steering shaft is converted by the steering gearbox into angular oscillation of the pitman arm (drop arm), which in turn imparts reciprocating linear motion to the drag link to steer the road wheels.

subject: AMVI
question: Super chargers are used to:
explanation: A supercharger is an engine-driven air compressor (driven mechanically by crankshaft belt/gears) used to force compressed air into the engine cylinders at a density higher than atmospheric pressure, allowing more fuel to burn and significantly boosting engine power output.

subject: AMVI
question: Pulverized coal is :

options.D: Coal which burn for long time

explanation: Pulverized coal is raw coal that has been crushed and ground in a pulverizing mill into a fine, dust-like powder, allowing it to be blown into thermal power station boilers with preheated air for rapid, complete, and efficient combustion.

subject: AMVI
question: Out of this one is not a polarity test:
explanation: A High Rate Discharge (HRD) test evaluates battery cell capacity and terminal voltage under a heavy cranking load of 150-200 A. It is a capacity/performance test, not a test to determine the positive and negative polarity of battery terminals.

subject: AMVI
question: Which is not the common component between a d.c generator and an alternator?
explanation: A DC generator uses a mechanical split-ring commutator to rectify internal AC current into external DC. An alternator uses continuous slip rings to feed field current to the rotor and converts AC to DC using a stationary semiconductor diode rectifier pack.

subject: AMVI
question: In vehicles using catalytic converter use:
explanation: Vehicles equipped with catalytic converters must use strictly unleaded fuel because tetraethyl lead compounds present in leaded petrol rapidly coat and permanently poison the precious metal catalysts (platinum, palladium, rhodium), deactivating them.

subject: AMVI
question: In the process of adiabatic expansion

options.A: Heat is not supplied or rejected
options.C: Hot and cold body are rejected

explanation: An adiabatic process is a thermodynamic process in which no heat enters or leaves the system from or to the surroundings (dQ = 0). During adiabatic expansion, work is done by the system entirely at the expense of its internal energy.

subject: AMVI
question: "Intensity of pressure at a point in a fluid at rest is same in all directions", this law is :
explanation: Pascal's Law of fluid statics states that the intensity of fluid pressure at any point in a static, incompressible fluid at rest is identical and equal in all directions.

subject: AMVI
question: In a positive crank case ventilation system, the blow by gases drawn from the crankcase is fed to the

options.B: Air vent opened to the atmosphere

explanation: In a Positive Crankcase Ventilation (PCV) system, crankcase blow-by gases containing unburned hydrocarbons and moisture are drawn through the PCV valve into the engine inlet manifold to be burned cleanly inside the combustion chambers.

subject: AMVI
question: A car which runs along a straight level road at a speed of 36 km/hr is brought to rest in 2 seconds by applying the brakes. The stopping distance is:
explanation: Calculation: Initial speed u = 36 km/h = 36 * (5/18) = 10 m/s. Final speed v = 0 m/s in time t = 2 s. Deceleration a = (u - v) / t = (10 - 0) / 2 = 5 m/s^2. Stopping distance s = u*t - (1/2)*a*t^2 = 10*2 - 0.5*5*(2^2) = 20 - 10 = 10 metres.

subject: AMVI
question: E.G.R. is employed to reduce :
explanation: Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) is an engine emission control technique that routes a metered fraction of inert exhaust gas back into the engine intake air to lower peak combustion temperatures, thereby drastically reducing the formation of toxic oxides of nitrogen (NOx) emissions.

subject: AMVI
question: Engine placed at the rear with rear axles as live axles:

options.A: Ensure better stability at high speeds
options.B: Ensure simple mechanism to operate engine and transmission system
options.C: Ensure greater accessibility for service and repair

explanation: Rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout vehicles concentrate weight over the driving wheels, which ensures good starting traction and high-speed directional stability on straight highways, though it tends toward oversteer during rapid cornering.

subject: AMVI
question: Vehicle weight when it is not loaded with passengers and cargo, but inclusive of the weight of full tank fuel, is known as:
explanation: Curb weight (kerb weight) is the total weight of a motor vehicle in complete operational running order, including a full tank of fuel, engine oil, coolant, spare tyre, and standard equipment, but excluding passengers and cargo.

subject: AMVI
question: The law which gives the relation between volume and temperature of a perfect gas when pressure is kept constant is known as:
explanation: Charles's Law states that for a given mass of an ideal gas at constant pressure, the volume is directly proportional to its absolute temperature (V / T = constant).

subject: AMVI
question: Top of the wheel slants vertically outward is called :
explanation: When the top of the road wheel tilts outward away from the vehicle center line when viewed from the front, it is called Positive Camber. If the top of the wheel tilts inward toward the center, it is called Negative Camber.

subject: AMVI
question: The brake power of an internal combustion engine can be found out with the help of :
explanation: The brake power (shaft output power) of an internal combustion engine is directly measured on an engine test bed using a brake dynamometer (such as a Prony brake, hydraulic dynamometer, or eddy-current dynamometer).

subject: AMVI
question: D.C series motors are widely employed for starting automobile engines because d.c series motors have:
explanation: DC series motors (where the field winding is connected in series with the armature winding) are universally employed as engine starter motors because they develop exceptionally high starting torque at low speeds / stall, precisely when breakaway engine cranking resistance is highest.

subject: AMVI
question: Idle stroke
explanation: In a conventional four-stroke internal combustion engine cycle, only the expansion (power) stroke produces positive mechanical work. The remaining three strokes—Suction, Compression, and Exhaust—consume energy (supplied by the flywheel) and are termed idle strokes.

subject: AMVI
question: Most tyre wearing angle is:
explanation: Incorrect camber angle (excessive positive or negative camber) causes severe and rapid tyre wear concentrated on one shoulder/edge of the tyre tread (inside edge for negative camber, outside edge for positive camber).

subject: AMVI
question: Tachometer measures:
explanation: A tachometer (RPM meter) is an instrument mounted on the vehicle dashboard that measures and displays the rotational speed of the engine crankshaft in revolutions per minute (RPM).

subject: AMVI
question: R.C.P. pistons are;
explanation: R.C.P. stands for Ring Carrier Piston (or Ring Carrier insert type piston), where a cast iron or austenitic steel insert is molecularly bonded into the aluminium piston crown to house the top compression ring groove, preventing ring groove wear in heavy-duty diesel engines.

subject: AMVI
question: The purpose of a radiator pressure cap is to maintain the working pressure of a water cooling system:
explanation: A radiator pressure cap seals the cooling system and maintains an internal pressure higher than atmospheric pressure (typically 0.9 to 1.2 bar above atmospheric). This raises the boiling point of the water coolant to around 110°C-120°C, preventing boiling and allowing higher operating efficiency.

subject: AMVI
question: Differential lock is provided:

options.A: To reduce the speed of inner wheel and to increase the speed of outer wheels.
options.B: To reduce the speed of outer wheel and to increase the speed of inner wheels.

explanation: A differential lock (diff-lock) locks the differential pinions or splines the two axle half-shafts together so that both drive wheels turn at identical speeds regardless of surface traction, preventing complete loss of drive when one wheel encounters ice, mud, or slippery terrain.

subject: AMVI
question: In a SU carburettor area of the throat is varied by:
explanation: In an S.U. (Skinners Union) constant-depression carburettor, the effective area of the venturi throat is automatically varied by the vertical rise and fall of the air piston (vacuum piston), which simultaneously moves a tapered metering needle inside the fuel jet.

subject: AMVI
question: In a reversed elliot type stub axle, the kingpin is locked to the:
explanation: In a reversed Elliot type front stub axle, the ends of the front axle beam are forged in the form of a fork (yoke), while the stub axle has a single eye. The kingpin passes through the fork and is securely locked to the front axle beam by a cotter pin.

subject: AMVI
question: Motorcar frame must be barrow in front:

options.B: To allow maximum comfort to drive
options.C: To allow room for spring action
options.D: To permit driver to visualize front objects

explanation: The chassis frame of a motorcar is made narrower at the front than at the rear to provide adequate clearance (room) for the front road wheels to turn through large steering angles (steering lock) without interfering with the frame members, thereby enabling a smaller turning circle radius.

subject: AMVI
question: Which among the followings is not a merit of front engine with front wheel drive vehicles?

options.A: Better tractive effort when going uphill

explanation: In a front-engine, front-wheel-drive (FF) vehicle, when ascending a steep hill, vehicle dynamic weight transfers towards the rear axle, which reduces the normal load and tractive adhesion on the front driving wheels. Hence, 'better tractive effort going uphill' is NOT a merit of FF vehicles.

subject: AMVI
question: The maximum bending moment due to moving load on a simply supported beam, occurs :
explanation: When a single concentrated moving point load rolls across a simply supported beam, the absolute maximum bending moment under the load at any instant occurs directly beneath the load itself.

subject: AMVI
question: The negative plate of a fully discharged lead acid battery contains:
explanation: During chemical discharge of a lead-acid battery, both the positive plate (lead peroxide) and the negative plate (spongy lead) react with sulfuric acid electrolyte to form lead sulphate (PbSO4) on both plates: Pb + PbO2 + 2H2SO4 -> 2PbSO4 + 2H2O.

subject: AMVI
question: A gear box is used to

options.A: To increase torque and reduce speed
options.B: To increase speed and reduce torque

explanation: A gearbox (transmission) provides multiple gear ratios to increase torque while reducing speed (for starting, climbing gradients), to increase vehicle speed while reducing torque (for cruising), and to provide a reverse gear position for driving backwards.

subject: AMVI
question: As per the BIS (Bureau of Indian Standards) 2000 specification, the permissible amount of sulphur content in gasoline is limited to:
explanation: Under the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specifications for India 2000 (Euro I equivalent) automotive fuels, the maximum permissible sulphur content in gasoline (petrol) was restricted to 1000 ppm (0.10% by mass). Later BS-VI reduced this to 10 ppm.

subject: AMVI
question: In case of a friction clutch, the pressure plate held against the clutch plate by:
explanation: In an automotive friction clutch, the pressure plate is clamped firmly against the clutch friction disc and flywheel by strong helical thrust coil springs (or a single diaphragm spring) housed in the clutch cover assembly.

subject: AMVI
question: The unbalanced wheel gives rise the problem of :
explanation: Dynamic or static unbalance of a road wheel and tyre assembly generates rotating centrifugal forces that induce severe steering wheel shake, tyre wobble (shimmy), and high-speed vibrations.

subject: AMVI
question: Progressive starting system is provided in:
explanation: The progressive cold-starting system (known as the 'Bi-starter') is a unique auxiliary starting carburettor circuit incorporated into the Solex carburettor that provides a rich mixture for initial cold cranking and can be leaned out progressively as the engine warms up.

subject: AMVI
question: Viscosity index is;

options.A: Rate of change of viscosity of oil with change in temperature
options.B: Resistance to flow of a fluid

explanation: Viscosity Index (VI) is an empirical number indicating the rate of change of a lubricating oil's viscosity with variations in temperature. A higher viscosity index indicates relatively little change in viscosity over a wide operating temperature range.

subject: AMVI
question: All of the following parameters hamper knocking tendency in a compression ignition engine, except:
explanation: In a compression ignition (diesel) engine, knocking is caused by an excessively long ignition delay. Early injection of fuel injects fuel into a cylinder at lower air temperature and pressure, which increases ignition delay and worsens knocking tendency.

subject: AMVI
question: Spark developed in spark plug when :

options.C: B. Point opens    C. Ignition switch on

explanation: In a conventional Kettering ignition system, high secondary ignition voltage is induced across the spark plug electrodes at the precise instant when the distributor contact breaker (C.B.) points open, causing the primary magnetic flux in the ignition coil core to collapse abruptly.

subject: AMVI
question: According to Darcy's formula loss of head due to friction in a pipe is
explanation: In fluid mechanics textbooks following standard civil/mechanical conventions, Darcy's formula for frictional head loss in a pipe of length L and diameter d is expressed as: hf = (4 * f * L * v^2) / (2 * g * d), where f is the Fanning friction coefficient.

subject: AMVI
question: Function of flywheel in 2 stroke engine

options.B: Act as permanent magnet for magneto

explanation: In small two-stroke engines (such as in scooters and mopeds), the flywheel performs multiple roles: storing kinetic energy to smooth out cyclic fluctuations, carrying permanent ceramic magnets on its rim to act as the rotor for the flywheel magneto ignition system, and incorporating external cast fins to act as a cooling fan.

subject: AMVI
question: Soot is a type of :
explanation: Soot is an impure carbonaceous particulate exhaust emission produced by the incomplete combustion of hydrocarbon fuels, predominantly emitted by diesel internal combustion engines as Particulate Matter (PM).

subject: AMVI
question: Escape of combustion gas past the rings into the crank case is called:
explanation: The leakage or escape of high-pressure combustion gases and unburned fuel vapor past the piston rings into the engine crankcase during compression and power strokes is known as 'blow-by'.

subject: AMVI
question: A hydro electric power station is commonly constructed at :
explanation: Hydroelectric power stations are constructed in hilly or mountainous regions where high natural topographical elevations provide a large hydraulic head (potential energy) for the stored water in reservoirs.

subject: AMVI
question: Which one of the followings is a false statement as regards to a synchromesh gear box?

options.A: The synchronising unit is locked to the main shaft
options.B: Main shaft gears are always free to rotate on the main shaft
options.C: The main shaft gears and the corresponding lay shaft gears are always in constant mesh
options.D: At a particular gear position, power flow takes place from main shaft gear to the synchronising unit and then to the main shaft

explanation: In a synchromesh gearbox, mainshaft gears are mounted on needle roller bearings and are free to rotate on the mainshaft only when in neutral. When a gear is selected and engaged via the synchronizer sleeve dog teeth, it becomes locked to the mainshaft. Hence, the statement that they are 'always free to rotate' is false.

subject: AMVI
question: Hydrometer is used to

options.B: Measure the specific gravity of electrolyte

explanation: A hydrometer is used to measure the specific gravity of the liquid electrolyte (dilute sulphuric acid) in a lead-acid storage battery, which directly indicates the chemical state of charge of the battery cells (typically 1.260-1.280 fully charged, 1.150 discharged).

subject: AMVI
question: One of the following property is not related to hardness:

options.D: Retain original shape and size after the removal of load

explanation: Hardness is the property of a material to resist surface penetration, scratching, abrasion, cutting, and indentation. The ability to retain original shape and size after removal of an applied load is the definition of elasticity, not hardness.

subject: AMVI
question: As steam expands in turbine :
explanation: As high-pressure steam expands through the nozzles and moving blades of a steam turbine, its pressure and temperature decrease continuously, causing its specific volume (v, in m^3/kg) to expand and increase enormously.

subject: AMVI
question: Piston pin offsetting is provided to:
explanation: Piston pin offsetting (locating the gudgeon pin axis 1 to 2 mm slightly off-center toward the major thrust side) causes the piston to tilt gradually and change contact from one cylinder wall to the other before TDC, eliminating or reducing piston slap noise.

subject: AMVI
question: Pump is a machine which converts
explanation: A pump is a hydraulic machine that converts mechanical energy (supplied by an electric motor or IC engine) into hydraulic energy (pressure energy and kinetic energy) of a liquid.

subject: AMVI
question: Venturimeter is used to :

options.A: pressure difference of liquid flowing between two point in a pipeline
options.B: measure of the pressure of flowing liquid
options.C: measure the discharge of liquid flowing in a pipe
options.D: measure the velocity of the liquid

explanation: A venturimeter is a hydraulic flow-measuring instrument based on Bernoulli's theorem, installed in a pipeline to measure the volumetric rate of flow (discharge) of a fluid passing through the pipe.

subject: AMVI
question: Variable rated spring:
explanation: A variable-rate (progressive) suspension spring (such as a progressive coil spring or helper leaf spring) has a spring rate that increases as it deflects under load, providing a soft, comfortable ride when the vehicle is empty and stiffening to carry heavy loads without bottoming out.

subject: AMVI
question: Which statement is true in the context of a torque tube type rear axle drive?

options.A: Side thrust is taken by the torque tube

explanation: In a torque tube drive, the propeller shaft is completely enclosed within a rigid tubular torque tube bolted rigidly to the differential casing and pivoted at the front to the gearbox through a spherical torque ball. Because the tube swings about a fixed center of radius, no sliding slip joint is required on the propeller shaft.

subject: AMVI
question: In one dimensional flow, the flow :
explanation: In one-dimensional fluid flow, the flow velocity and other fluid properties are functions of time and only one space coordinate along a straight streamline or flow line.

subject: AMVI
question: Micros bus can carry:
explanation: Under automotive vehicle body classification: a micro bus is designed to carry 8 to 15 passengers; a mini bus carries 16 to 30 passengers; a standard passenger bus carries 41 to 60 passengers; and large/articulated buses carry over 60 passengers.

subject: AMVI
question: Track rod is connected to track arm by:
explanation: In automobile steering linkage, the track rod (tie rod) is connected to the steering track arms on both sides by flexible ball-and-socket joints (ball joints) that permit relative angular steering movements and vertical suspension deflection without binding.

subject: AMVI
question: Engine overhauling indicates:
explanation: Symptoms indicating that an engine requires major overhauling include: excessive fuel consumption (due to loss of compression), excessive lubricating oil consumption (due to worn piston rings and valve guides), and excessive exhaust smoke (blow-by and oil burning).

subject: AMVI
question: Reason for clutch slip is:
explanation: Clutch slip occurs when the friction disc fails to grip the flywheel and pressure plate firmly. Primary causes include oil or grease on the friction linings, broken or weakened pressure springs, and worn-out friction facings.

subject: AMVI
question: The most attractive feature of engines made of aluminium alloys is:
explanation: The most advantageous feature of automotive engines constructed with aluminium alloy cylinder blocks and heads is their low density (roughly one-third that of cast iron), which provides a very low weight-to-power ratio, improving vehicle fuel economy and acceleration.

subject: AMVI
question: Water hammer is developed in a :
explanation: Water hammer is a transient hydraulic shock pressure surge created in the hydroelectric penstock pipe when the water turbine inlet control valve or governor gate is closed suddenly. A surge tank is installed along the penstock to relieve this shock pressure.

subject: AMVI
question: Final driver consist of
explanation: The final drive in an automobile transmission consists of a bevel pinion and crown wheel (or hypoid gears). It provides a permanent gear reduction (typically 3:1 to 5:1) and turns the drive line through a 90-degree right angle from the propeller shaft to the drive axles.

subject: AMVI
question: A cylindrical section having no joint is called :
explanation: A seamless section (such as a seamless steel pipe or cylinder) is a tubular product manufactured by extrusion or rotary piercing without any longitudinal or circumferential welded seam/joint, ensuring uniform strength.

subject: AMVI
question: The part of a piston intended to strengthen the piston head so as to withstand the force of explosion is:
explanation: Piston webs are internal reinforcing ribs or gussets cast beneath the piston crown (head) connecting it to the gudgeon pin bosses, designed to withstand the immense explosive gas pressure forces without deflecting.

subject: AMVI
question: The state of charge of a lead acid battery under actual operating conditions can be tested by:
explanation: The High Discharge Test (using a heavy-duty battery cell discharge tester) measures the terminal voltage of each individual cell while drawing a heavy current (150 to 200 A) for 10-15 seconds, accurately evaluating the internal condition and state of charge under simulated starting loads.

subject: AMVI
question: Automobile gears are generally made of;
explanation: Automobile transmission gears are manufactured from case-hardening alloy steels (such as nickel-chromium, nickel-molybdenum, or chrome-vanadium steels) to provide a hard, wear-resistant surface tooth flank and a tough, shock-absorbing tooth core.

subject: AMVI
question: Skidding of wheels avoided by :
explanation: Uncontrolled wheel lockup and lateral skidding during panic braking are prevented by the Anti-lock Braking System (ABS), which monitors wheel speeds and automatically modulates hydraulic brake line pressure to maintain rolling traction.

subject: AMVI
question: What happens when cutch pedal is depressed?

options.C: Pressure plate moves away from flywheel
options.D: Clutch disc is pressed by pressure plate towards flywheel

explanation: When the driver depresses the clutch pedal, the release bearing pushes against the release levers or diaphragm spring fingers, which pulls the clutch pressure plate backward away from the flywheel, removing the clamping friction force and disengaging the clutch disc.

subject: AMVI
question: Coil springs used for automobile suspension system can withstand:
explanation: When an automobile suspension coil spring is compressed vertically, the circular wire cross-section is subjected to torsional shear stress along with direct shear and slight bending stress. Coil springs cannot withstand torque reaction or lateral thrust.

subject: AMVI
question: Bent of a valve stem can be straightened by:
explanation: A bent engine valve stem cannot be safely straightened by any workshop method; cold straightening induces micro-cracks and residual stresses leading to catastrophic valve head detachment during engine operation. A bent valve must be discarded and replaced.

subject: AMVI
question: A sliding mesh gearbox has a gear ratio 4:1 at the third gear position. The clutch shaft gear has 15 teeth and its mating lay shaft gear is having 45 teeth. If the main shaft gear contains 28 teeth, the mating lay shaft gear should have:
explanation: Gear ratio calculation: Gear ratio G = (T_layshaft_driven / T_clutch_driver) * (T_mainshaft_driven / T_layshaft_driver). Given G = 4:1, T_clutch_driver = 15, T_layshaft_driven = 45, T_mainshaft_driven = 28: 4 = (45 / 15) * (28 / T) = 3 * (28 / T) = 84 / T. Therefore, T = 84 / 4 = 21 teeth.

subject: AMVI
question: Which transmission unit is used to turn the driven shaft faster than the driving shaft?
explanation: An overdrive is an auxiliary planetary gear unit placed behind the transmission that provides a gear step-up (gear ratio less than 1:1, typically 0.7:1 to 0.8:1), turning the output propeller shaft faster than the engine crankshaft to lower engine RPM during high-speed highway cruising.

subject: AMVI
question: 'By pass port' in a master cylinder helps to:

options.A: Fill the brake fluid in the compression chamber when brakes are applied
options.B: Destroy the vacuum created in the compression chamber at the moment when brake pedal is released
options.C: Convey the excess fluid accumulated in the compression chamber to the reservoir after brakes are released
options.D: Return the brake fluid to the compression chamber after brakes are released

explanation: The bypass port (compensating port) in a hydraulic brake master cylinder allows excess brake fluid resulting from fluid expansion during high operating temperatures to return freely from the compression chamber back into the fluid reservoir when the brake pedal is released.

subject: AMVI
question: Direction of flow of water through the radiator in thermosyphon cooling system is from:
explanation: In a thermosyphon cooling system, natural thermal convection causes hot water from the engine to rise and enter the radiator at the top tank. As the water cools by air passing through the radiator core fins, its density increases, causing it to flow downwards from top to bottom, returning to the engine from the bottom tank.

subject: AMVI
question: R.P.M. of an engine can be measured with :
explanation: The rotational speed of an internal combustion engine crankshaft in revolutions per minute (RPM) is measured and indicated by a tachometer (tacometer).

subject: AMVI
question: An oxidation catalyst that commonly used in catalytic converters is:
explanation: Platinum (Pt) and Palladium (Pd) are noble metals widely used as oxidation catalysts in automotive catalytic converters to promote the oxidation of unburned hydrocarbons (HC) and carbon monoxide (CO) into harmless water vapor (H2O) and carbon dioxide (CO2).

subject: AMVI
question: Over drive is used to :

options.D: Maintain wheel r.p.m. without engine support

explanation: An overdrive unit is installed in an automobile transmission to step up the gear ratio (providing a gear ratio of less than 1:1, e.g. 0.75:1), turning the output propeller shaft faster than the engine crankshaft to lower engine speed, noise, and fuel consumption during highway cruising.

subject: AMVI
question: The property of the fluid by which molecules of different kinds of fluids are attracted to each other is called :
explanation: Adhesion is the physical intermolecular attractive force acting between molecules of different, dissimilar substances in contact (e.g. water molecules wetting glass). Cohesion is the attractive force between molecules of the same substance.

subject: AMVI
question: Turn ratio is associated with :
explanation: Turn ratio is an electrical transformer parameter associated with the ignition coil, representing the ratio of the number of turns in the high-tension secondary winding (typically 15,000 to 25,000 turns) to the number of turns in the low-tension primary winding (typically 150 to 250 turns), giving a step-up turns ratio of 100:1 or more.

subject: AMVI
question: ......... is reduced in turning operation :
explanation: Turning is a fundamental lathe machining operation in which a single-point cutting tool removes material along the longitudinal axis of a rotating cylindrical workpiece, reducing its external diameter.

subject: AMVI
question: Acme thread has ......... degree angle :
explanation: An Acme screw thread is a trapezoidal power transmission thread having an included flank angle of 29 degrees, widely used on machine tool lead screws and jacks due to its high strength and ease of disengagement with split nuts.

subject: AMVI
question: In Hutch kiss driver torque reaction is taken by
explanation: In a Hotchkiss drive rear suspension, the drive thrust and torque reaction are both taken entirely by the road leaf springs (semi-elliptic leaf springs clamped rigidly to the rear axle casing). In a torque tube drive, torque reaction is resisted by the rigid torque tube.

question: Kinematic viscosity is the :

options.A: ratio of absolute viscosity to the density of the liquid

options.D: product of absolute viscosity and density of the liquid

subject: AMVI
question: Forward efficiency is related to :
explanation: In automotive steering gear mechanisms, forward efficiency is the mechanical efficiency when steering torque is transmitted from the steering wheel input shaft to the output pitman arm shaft to turn the road wheels.
